'''Bolgoink''' was a settlement located on the [[Wugguh]] continent of [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. The village was controlled by the [[Bolgoink clan]], who maintained a [[Bolgoink Hold|clan hold]] in the settlement ruled by [[Matron/Legends|Matron]] [[Kufbrug]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fields outside Bolgoink hosted the [[Bolgoink Fair]] every year during [[slushtime]].<ref name="MS" />
